text:
# Study fund page: what I took from it

## 1. My answer: what I'd do and how sure I am

I would join the study fund. I'd plan to leave the money in for **6 full years**, until I'm about 67, and then take it all out without paying tax.

The page put it simply near the top: **"אחרי 6 שנים מההפקדה הראשונה אפשר למשוך את הכסף בלי מס הכנסה ובלי מס רווחי הון"** (after 6 years from the first deposit you can take the money out with no income tax and no capital gains tax). The chart says the same: on the right it's **"מ־6 שנים: פטור ממס"** (from 6 years: tax-free) and on the left it's pink **"לפני 6 שנים: מס"** (before 6 years: tax).

On how much: the page's example assumes I put in 300 ₪ a month and the employer puts in 900 ₪. After 5 years, about **66,500 ₪** would be **"נשאר בידיים"** (left in your hands). That's after tax, and only if I ask the tax office for money back. At 6 years there's no tax, so I'd guess something like 80,000 ₪, but I could only see the 5-year numbers, so that figure is mine, not the page's.

How sure am I? **Fairly sure about "6 years, then tax-free."** **Not sure about the amount**, because it's their example salary, not mine. **Not sure whether my age changes things.** One line says **"למי שהגיע לגיל הפרישה מספיקות 3 שנים"** (if you've reached retirement age, 3 years is enough). I'm 61, so that matters a lot to me, and I couldn't work out whether I'd count.

## 2. Parts I actually used

- **The opening section, "מה זה"** (What it is): the rules on 6 years and 3 years.
- **The calculator, "כמה כסף נשאר לכם, ומתי?"** (How much money is left for you, and when?): the four boxes, the bar chart and the five-column result.
- **The paragraph under the calculator** that starts **"משיכה אחרי 5 שנים"** (withdrawal after 5 years).
- **The tax section**, especially the line **"מגיל 60 המדרגות מתחילות נמוך יותר"** (from age 60 the tax brackets start lower), because that's me.
- **The orange warning box**: **"לא כל הסכום מגיע לחשבון"** (not all of the amount reaches your account).

## 3. Going down the page

- **Title and short description**: I used it. "Savings through your job, and after a time set by law you can take it out tax-free." That's clear.
- **The small line "123 ממקור, 123 מחושב, מונח"** (from a source, calculated, term): I skipped it. I didn't understand what it was for.
- **"מה זה"** (What it is): used it carefully. The 6 years and the 3 years are the heart of it for me. The line about the limit of **15,712 ₪** I skimmed. I think it means only salary up to that amount gets the tax benefit.
- **"חוקים וכללים · 10"** (laws and rules · 10) and the round buttons **"מסלול כללי"** (general track), **"S&P 500"**, **"אג"ח ממשלתית צמודה"** (index-linked government bonds), **"מזומן שקלי"** (shekel cash): I skipped them. That's investment talk. I'd ask my bank adviser or my son.
- **The calculator**: used it the most (details in section 4).
- **The small print under the calculator**: I read it and half understood it. **"התשואה 7% בשנה... הנחות של האתר, לא תחזית"** (7% return a year… the site's assumptions, not a forecast) told me the numbers aren't promised, and I'm glad they said so. The line about the S&P500 track and fees I skimmed.
- **"שווה לדעת"** (Worth knowing): I skimmed it. **"אחרי משיכה... השנים נספרות מחדש"** (after a withdrawal… the years start counting again) is worth remembering: don't take money out early. The codes **KH-19, KH-15, PF-18** meant nothing to me.
- **"מי מציע ומי מצטרף"** (Who offers it and who joins): skimmed. The employer picks it, the companies are named, fine.
- **"משיכה ומעבר"** (Withdrawal and transfer): skimmed. "Up to 4 business days" to get the money is reassuring. The part about two funds being counted as one account confused me.
- **"כמה זה עולה"** (What it costs): skimmed. **"דמי יציאה: לא גובים"** (exit fees: not charged) was good to see. **"הוצאות ישירות"** (direct expenses) and **"לא נמצאה תקרה כוללת"** (no overall cap was found) worried me a little, but I didn't understand it.
- **The tax section**: used it, but slowly. **"עד 25% מהחלק שמעל האינפלציה"** (up to 25% of the part above inflation) is about money over the limit, so I don't think it applies to me.
- **The orange box**: it confused me at first. It says the fund sends **47%** straight to the tax office and you only get some back if you ask. So taking money out early really does cost something.
- **The Treasury economist paragraph**: read it and it worried me: **"ממליץ לצמצם את ההטבה"** (recommends cutting the benefit). But **"כרגע הפטור בתוקף"** (for now the exemption is in force). I'll keep an eye on it.
- **"סיכונים ומה מוגן"** (Risks and what's protected): read it. **"המדינה לא ערבה"** (the state doesn't guarantee it) is honest, but at my age I don't like hearing it. **"מי שהיא חייבת לו כסף לא יכול לעקל אותו"** (people the company owes money to can't seize it) calmed me down.
- **"מונחים"** (Terms): skipped it, apart from **"ותק"** (seniority), which confirmed it's counted from the first payment.
- **Footer**: skipped it, apart from **"נתונים נכון ל־05.11.2026"** (data correct as of 05.11.2026). Good, it's recent.

## 4. The chart and the columns

**The four boxes:** I looked at all of them: my deposit **2.5%**, the employer's **7.5%**, the yearly return **7%** and the management fee **0.54%**. I didn't change anything, because I don't know my real figures yet.

**The bar chart:**
- I looked at the **dashed line between 5 and 6** and the two labels above it. That was the most useful thing on the page.
- I noticed the **pink striped tops on years 1 to 5**. I understood them as the tax.
- I looked at the **circled 5** and the title **"מושכים את הכסף אחרי 5 שנים"** (taking the money out after 5 years).
- The **colours inside the bars** (grey, yellow, green) I ignored, because the chart has no key. I guessed grey is my money and yellow is the employer's.
- The note **"גררו את הסמן"** (drag the marker) I read, but I couldn't try it on screenshots. So I never saw the number for 6 years or more.

**The result columns:**
- I looked mostly at **"המעסיק הוסיף +54,000"** (the employer added), **"המס לקח −13,974"** (tax took) and the white **"נשאר בידיים 66,5…"** (left in your hands). The last number was cut off by the arrow button.
- **"הפקדתם"** (you deposited), my own column, had no number I could see.
- **"התשואה הוסיפה אחרי דמי ניהול +8,487"** (the return added after management fees) I noted. It's small next to what the employer adds.

**The underlined numbers:** I ignored the purple and grey underlining. I didn't know what it meant.

## 5. What I didn't understand

- **"מס רווחי הון"** (capital gains tax). I roughly know, but not exactly.
- Why the after-5-years paragraph has three different numbers: 50,719, 29,768 and 15,794. And which one I actually get if I don't file for a refund. I think it's the 50,719, but I'm not certain.
- **"הפקדה מוטבת"** (benefited deposit), **"משכורת קובעת"** (determining salary) and **"מסלול מדד"** (index track).
- The colours inside the bars.
- What **"חוקים וכללים"** (laws and rules) with a number does, and what **KH-19** is.
- **"הוצאות ישירות... לא נמצאה תקרה כוללת"** (direct expenses… no overall cap was found): does that mean they can charge me as much as they like?

## 6. What I wanted to know and couldn't find

- **What exactly is "גיל הפרישה" (retirement age) for me, and does the 3-year rule apply if I reach it while the money is in the fund?** If it does, I might be able to take it out at 64–67 instead of 67. That's the most important question for me, and the page doesn't explain it.
- **The amount for my own salary.** The example is 12,000 ₪, and I don't know my real salary or my employer's percentages yet.
- **The number at 6 and 7 years**, which I couldn't see.
- **What happens if I stop working or retire before the 6 years are up.** There's a box "מה קורה כשהמעסיק מפסיק להפקיד" (what happens when the employer stops paying in), but its answer is "depends on the company".
- **Whether I can leave the money in after I can withdraw it**, and whether it keeps growing.
- **Whether I have to tell the tax office anything when I take it out after 6 years.**

## 7. If half the page had to go, this goes first

1. **The "מונחים" (Terms) list** at the bottom.
2. **All the round buttons** for investment tracks (S&P 500, government bonds and so on).
3. **The "123 ממקור / מחושב" line** and the **"חוקים וכללים"** labels everywhere.
4. **"משיכה ומעבר"** (Withdrawal and transfer): the details about moving between funds.
5. **The Treasury economist paragraph.**

**What I'd keep, no matter what:** the opening "מה זה", the calculator with the 5/6-year line, the orange warning box, and the line about **age 60**.
